rows.title: Watch the scammer’s reaction when he sees the dashcam.
rows.description:
VIDEO CREDIT: @hudsonkuang2529 

Insurance fraud attempt in Queens, NY 10-16-2024 PART 1
I was driving in the left lane of the Belt Parkway going East bound towards the Southern State Parkway. The silver Honda (LBB 8917) was in the middle lane, and they cut me off and slammed on the brakes coming to a full stop hoping I would hit them. I did not hit their car and because of that they reversed into my car for collision and acted as if they were injured while coming out of their vehicle. 

I believe the intention was to say I hit their car for insurance fraud purposes. They had a tarp covering the rear windshield which fell off once they hit my car. You can see the driver is a male wearing a hat and you can see him switching to the passenger seat as well as the movement of the car before anyone gets out. 

The first three passengers exit the car pretending to be hurt, while the fourth passenger who was driving slips out through the passenger seat and gets into a second vehicle. 

That second vehicle was a red KIA SUV (KJH 3340) which was following me from behind and keeping distance so they wouldn't slam into me. The red KIA drove around and picked up the driver to get away. 

The remaining three people’s demeanor changed once one of them noticed the dashcam. They only came out of the car with their phones ready to record the damage to both cars. 

They were quick to ask for my insurance and quickly left after the exchange. I called the police at the time of the incident and reported it as an accident, and the police told me they no longer go to an accident if no one is injured and they are willing to exchange information. 

I did not realize at the time that the driver switched and left in another car or that it was a set-up as I was driving by myself, and everything happened so fast.

An Orlando Police officer is facing charges after being pulled over by a sheriff's deputy and then fleeing during a traffic stop.

RELATED: Traffic stop turns into dance lesson when driver teaches cop new moves https://youtu.be/BCJn8PrOFes

A heated confrontation between a Florida sheriff's deputy and an Orlando police officer was caught on a body cam after the deputy pulled the officer over for allegedly speeding in a marked police SUV. The officer sped off and was later arrested.

According to a Seminole County Sheriff's Office report, a deputy on routine patrol stopped Orlando Police Officer Alexander Shaouni on June 6 at 12:15 p.m. local time for driving nearly twice the speed limit along a stretch of road. During the stop, footage shows Shaouni dressed in police uniform driving a marked Orlando Police Department SUV.

rows.title: Traffic camera footage shows driver of sports car lose control and crash, killing her passenger
tags: Traffic camera footage shows driver of sports car lose control and crash
u.S. Ambassador to China Gary Locke
rows.description:
Newly obtained traffic camera footage shows the moment the driver of a sports car in Bellevue lost control and crashed the vehicle she was driving, killing her passenger. 

The driver, 26-year-old Ting Ye, has been charged with vehicular homicide but, according to police, has left the country for China. 

Traffic cameras across several intersections document the flash of a white Porsche that police say was driven by Ye on Sept. 30 around 4 a.m.

The vehicle hit a cement barricade and went airborne. Investigators say Ye, the driver, survived and her passenger, 27-year-old Yabao Liu died. According to court documents, a first responder noted the “strong odor of alcohol coming from the defendant’s breath.”

Court records allege Ye did not cooperate with investigators and has since fled to her home country of China.    

Former Washington Governor and former U.S. Ambassador to China Gary Locke points to the lack of an extradition treaty between the two countries.

“The story is not over. Yes, she was able to elude the arrest warrant, but if she were to ever travel to another country, let’s say to Europe on business or pleasure to an area, to a country that does have an extradition treaty with the United States she’ll be flagged when she enters that country by Interpol and subject to extradition back to the United States if the United States government so desires,” Locke said.

FULL STORY: https://www.wfaa.com/article/news/crime/new-video-driver-crashing-into-barricade-bellevue-killing-passenger/281-b2e386c9-c0d1-4082-8c3a-c9e22d175010

rows.title: Lying NYPD Cop Gets CAUGHT On Dash Cam
rows.description:
Ben was driving in New York City when he noticed an NYPD vehicle driving along with no lights on. As Ben began passing the police car, the officer made a sudden U turn without signaling, plowing into Ben's Lexus before immediately activating the car's emergency lighting.  Notice that the cop car had no lights on at all before the brakes were applied, which illuminated the brake lights.

Then it turned with still no headlights, turn signals, or emergency lights active. It wasn't until after the impact that the officer activated the emergency lights, but Ben told us they said in their official report that the emergency lights were already active and that Ben had failed to yield. The NYPD sent Ben a bill for 14,000 USD to repair their police car.

After he sent them a copy of his dash cam footage, they backed off before covering Ben's 7,500 USD repair bill.
_
Dashcam Stories is a collection of real-life experiences from various drivers, captured through their vehicle's dashcams. These incidents are documented by cameras mounted on dashboards and submitted to this channel by a community of driving enthusiasts. I personally reach out to each individual who shares their footage to delve deeper into their experiences and to catch up on the events that unfold beyond what's visible in their clips. Narration and text overlays are incorporated to clarify the circumstances and reasons behind each incident. I believe that providing this context not only enhances the storytelling but also elevates the educational value of the content.

Through these videos and the supplementary insights, viewers are exposed to the repercussions of poor driving habits, encouraging them to adopt safer driving practices. My goal is to infuse these stories with originality and creativity, transforming them in a way that both entertains and educates our audience.
